result.summary: Found 3 visual issues on the food delivery app page, including truncated content, duplicate restaurant listings, and a partially visible card.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' section is partially cut off, showing only part of the image and truncated text 'Smash Bros Bu' instead of the full name.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the horizontal scroll list shows a consistent peek of the next card to indicate scrollability, but the text below should not be truncated without ellipsis or should be fully visible.

issues.description: Two identical 'Green Bowl Poké' restaurant cards appear side by side in the 'Fastest near you' section with the same delivery time (15-25 min) and price (€0.90), suggesting a data duplication bug.
issues.suggestion: Investigate the data source to ensure duplicate restaurant entries are deduplicated before rendering in the carousel.

issues.description: The bottom pizza restaurant card is cut off mid-image with no restaurant name or details visible, giving the impression of incomplete content load.
issues.suggestion: Either show a partial card intentionally to hint at scrolling, or ensure enough of the card (including name/details) is visible to be useful to the user.
